extraction_notes: Ordering-code identity is preserved: the PDF title and page headers identify T2N7002BK; the requested ordering code is recorded as T2N7002BK,LM.

The datasheet states Silicon N-Channel MOS, so polarity is n. Unless otherwise specified, electrical tables are at Ta = 25 degC; curve values are typical reference curves and are not guaranteed by production test.
Vth has no typical column: MIN = 1.1 V and MAX = 2.1 V at ID = 250 uA and VDS = VGS.
The three rdson_points retain the published TYP values. The corresponding published MAX values are 1.5 ohm at VGS = 10 V, 1.65 ohm at VGS = 5.0 V, and 1.75 ohm at VGS = 4.5 V, all at ID = 100 mA.
Ciss is 26 pF typical and 40 pF maximum; Coss is 5.5 pF typical and Crss is 1.3 pF typical. Coss and Crss have no published maximum in the table.
The body-diode field preserves the datasheet sign convention: typical VDSF is -0.79 V at ID = -115 mA and VGS = 0 V; the corresponding published maximum is -1.1 V.
Fig. 7.1, Fig. 7.2, and Fig. 7.7 points are visual digitizations of plotted traces only. Fig. 7.2 uses logarithmic ID; Fig. 7.7 uses logarithmic VDS and capacitance axes.
